sentences.text: Inguza predemersus is an extinct species of penguin.
Scientists identified a unique tarsometatarsus, a specific foot bone, to distinguish this animal.
Fossils were found in Late Pliocene rocks at a quarry in Langebaanweg, South Africa, dating to approximately 5 million years ago.
This creature belongs to the penguin family Spheniscidae.
Inguza predemersus serves as the type species for the genus Inguza.
The group existed from the Tortonian to the Zanclean stages, spanning between 11.63 and 3.6 million years ago.
Researchers debate whether Inguza predemersus is close to modern penguins or represents a late survivor of an extinct lineage.
